title: Denmark National Population Database Breached Using Simple Password
excerpt: A hacker accessed Denmark's national population database containing data on 8.8 million people by using the weak password '123456'.
body_html:
A significant data breach in Denmark has compromised the personal information of about 8.8 million individuals. Reports indicate that a hacker managed to access the nation's central population database by utilizing the extremely weak password '123456'.

The incident has brought serious attention to security practices surrounding major government and public sector databases. Unauthorized access to such large-scale repositories exposes sensitive citizen data, highlighting potential vulnerabilities in administrative credential management and system protection protocols.

Authorities and cybersecurity experts are currently examining the circumstances surrounding the breach and the methods used to secure the database. Further details regarding the full extent of the compromised information or subsequent remediation steps have not yet been fully disclosed.
